connect.alreadyConnectedLocally: This server is already connected to a chronicle. Run `/disconnect` first.
connect.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Codes last 15 minutes and work once; make a new one in Chronicle Setup.
connect.alreadyConnected: That chronicle is already connected to a Discord server. Its HST can disconnect it in Chronicle Setup.
connect.tooOld: That site doesn't run Beyond Elysium 1.6 or newer.
connect.success: Connected to *{gameName}*. Players can run `/link` now.
disconnect.notConnected: This server isn't connected to a chronicle.
disconnect.confirmPrompt: Disconnect this server from its chronicle?
disconnect.beUnreachableNote: The site may still show this server connected; its HST can disconnect it in Chronicle Setup.
shared.connectionEndedFromSite: This connection was ended from the chronicle's site.
shared.botDefect: Something went wrong on the bot's own side. This has been logged.
shared.unreachable: The chronicle's site didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
link.approved: You're linked to {characters}. Run `/link` again to change your characters.
link.confirmed: Your request is waiting for a Storyteller.
link.requested: Open this link while signed in to *{gameName}* to pick your characters. It expires {expiry}.
link.staffPing: {username} asked to link; `/links` to answer once they confirm on the site.
shared.userNotLinked: You're not linked here. Run `/link` first.
unlink.confirmPrompt: Unlink your Discord account from this chronicle?
unlink.error: Couldn't unlink right now. Try again in a moment.
shared.storytellersOnly: Only the chronicle's Storytellers can do that.
links.noneConfirmed: No requests are waiting for an answer.
character.invalidSelection: That's not one of your linked characters anymore. Try again.
character.noneActive: You have no active character. Run `/character <name>` to pick one.
character.activeCleared: Your active character is no longer linked to you, so it's been cleared. Run `/character <name>` to pick another.
sheet.noCharacter: You have no active character. Run `/character <name>` first, or name one here.
sheet.forbidden: You can only see your own characters.
sheet.characterNotFound: That character wasn't found in this chronicle.
sheet.sectionNotFound: That section wasn't found on this sheet.
sheet.publicOwnOnly: You can only post a character's sheet publicly when it's your own.
settings.staffChannelUnreachable: I can't post in {channel}. Check my permissions there and try again.
pool.clampedNote: (clamped: {pool} can't go below 0 or above its permanent rating)
pool.notFound: That pool wasn't found on this character.
pool.onlyOwnCharacter: You can only spend or regain your own character's pools.
wound.onlyOwnOrStaff: You can only wound or heal your own character.
night.closeSuccess: Session closed — pools and losses reset for every real attendee. Wounds carry over.
night.noOpenSession: No open session — run `/night open` first.
